# On-Device Control Quick Reference

## Control Namespaces

| Control | Family | Immediate action | Layer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ctrl0 | modulation/reactivity | Toggle EF | immediate |
| Ctrl1 | navigation/time | Next slot | immediate |
| Ctrl2 | arp/note | Cycle EF assignment | immediate |
| Ctrl3 | system/type | Cycle MIDI channel | immediate |
| Ctrl4 | edit/persistence | Cycle data number | immediate |
| Ctrl5 | tempo/diagnostics | Tap tempo | immediate |

## Gestures

| Gesture | Action | Layer | Family | Reversible |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Ctrl0+Ctrl1+Ctrl2` | Panic to profile baseline | immediate | system | No |
| `long-press Ctrl1` | Reload active profile | edit | persistence | No |
| `long-press Ctrl3` | Reload saved configuration | edit | persistence | No |
| `Ctrl1+Ctrl2` | Cycle profile | modifier | navigation | No |
| `long-press Ctrl4` | Save active profile | edit | persistence | No |
| `Ctrl2+Ctrl4` | Toggle arpeggiator | modifier | arp/note | Yes |
| `hold Ctrl2+Ctrl4` | Enter arpeggiator edit | edit | arp/note | Yes |
| `Ctrl2+Ctrl3` | Increment arpeggiator base note | modifier | arp/note | No |
| `hold Ctrl2+Ctrl3` | Cycle swing preset | edit | arp/note | Yes |
| `Ctrl4+Ctrl5` | Set slot to Note | modifier | midi type | No |
| `Ctrl3+Ctrl5` | Set slot to Program Change | modifier | midi type | No |
| `Ctrl0+Ctrl5` | Set slot to Pitch Bend | modifier | midi type | No |
| `Ctrl1+Ctrl4` | Set slot to Aftertouch | modifier | midi type | No |
| `Ctrl2+Ctrl5` | Set slot to NRPN | modifier | midi type | No |
| `Ctrl1+Ctrl3` | Set slot to RPN | modifier | midi type | No |
| `Ctrl0+Ctrl3` | Set slot to SysEx | modifier | midi type | No |
| `Ctrl0+Ctrl1` | Cycle ARG method | modifier | modulation/reactivity | No |
| `Ctrl0+Ctrl2` | Cycle ARG envelope pair | modifier | modulation/reactivity | No |
| `Ctrl0+Ctrl4` | Enable and randomize EF | modifier | modulation/reactivity | No |
| `Ctrl3+Ctrl4+Ctrl5` | Toggle USB MIDI output | modifier | system | Yes |
| `Ctrl3+Ctrl4` | Cycle LED mode | modifier | system | Yes |
| `Ctrl1+Ctrl5` | Toggle MIDI clock output | modifier | clock/time | Yes |
| `Ctrl1+Ctrl4+Ctrl5` | Toggle clock source | modifier | clock/time | Yes |
| `Ctrl0+Ctrl1+Ctrl3` | Toggle LFO tune mode | edit | modulation/reactivity | Yes |
| `Ctrl0+Ctrl1+Ctrl4` | Toggle live LFO 1 | modifier | modulation/reactivity | Yes |
| `Ctrl0+Ctrl2+Ctrl3+Ctrl5` | Toggle on-device config mode | edit | edit/persistence | No |
| `long-press Ctrl5` | Enter or cycle diagnostics | edit | system | Yes |
| `hold Ctrl0+Ctrl3+Ctrl4` | Tune jitter | edit | modulation/reactivity | Yes |
